Good to know

Before you reach out.

When will I hear back?

We respond every day between 9 AM and 9 PM. WhatsApp is usually the quickest way to reach the team.

Can I visit the office?

Yes. We are at Row House 6, Rilicon Fremount Hills CHS, Near Abhinav School, Ambegaon Bk., Pune. Call ahead so the right person is available to meet you.

Do you work with companies outside Pune?

Yes. Consulting and corporate training can be delivered online, so we can work with teams wherever they are.

What should a project enquiry include?

A short description of your business, your current system and what you want to achieve. We will take it from there.

How do I find out course fees and batch dates?

Choose the course in the form above and send it. We will reply with the current fee, the next batch dates and the available modes.
